inventory_summary: Inventoried: 62 ceilings (all 5/8" gwb/gwb-mr/gwb-x; sauna/plant special), 37 rooms' floor stacks, 36 doorways' adjacent floors, 6 drywall bead products + 20 termination / 8 tile-reveal / 4 L-bead / 4 LED / 36+36 window trims, 20 wall assemblies' gypsum + RC layers, 10 floor materials. Web-checked: Trim-Tex AS6010 (5/8x5/8 ok), AS8710 (1/2x1/2 ok), 9010 (1/2" ok), JT6 (5/8 mismatch), 7010 (3/4 radius; board-thickness meaning unclear), DITRA-HEAT 5.5mm, SurePly ~0.205", AR gypsum. Sheets opened: A-603, A-002, A-301, A-516, A-567 (5 of the requested set). Pass 2: opened 13 interior detail sheets in total (A-516, A-519, A-520, A-521, A-525, A-528, A-530, A-567, A-579, A-583 plus A-603, A-002, A-301); layer thicknesses (0.5/0.625 gwb, 3.5/5.5 studs, plant stack, sauna liner) all match the model; layer_bands.py and coatings.py walked: no nominal-vs-actual or band-height bug found (band clamp, reband and coating-restore logic are consistent; coatings take 0 depth). NOT examined: remaining A-517..A-584 sheets of the same families (identical patterns), Fry Reglet profiles, Johnsonite base thickness (O2 seam; listing found 0.080" vinyl vs rubber 1/8").
verified_clean: AS6010 Z shadow bead: A=5/8 matches the 5/8" ceiling board, B=5/8 reveal (Trim-Tex spec).
AS8710 F reveal 1/2x1/2 and 9010 1/2" tear-away L-bead match the 1/2" walls they sit on.
Ceilings: all 62 are 5/8" gypsum, 0.625" z-thickness; main bottom 107.5" and second 227.5" = 120 - 11 7/8 joist - 5/8; consistent per storey.
A-301 section clear heights (BATH2 8'-10", LIVING 8'-10 9/16", HALL 6'-11 5/8", WORKSHOP 8'-0 15/16") equal model clear_height_m (106.0, 106.55, 83.63, 96.94).
Wall gypsum thicknesses: 1/2" partitions/exterior liners; 5/8" kept on garage, stair-well, Type X walls per the wall board policy; resilient channel layer 1/2" matches RC-1 depth.
LVP 5 mm total (0.197") + 3/4" subfloor = 0.947" and coated cap 0.9375": 0.009" flush as documented.
Oak 3/4" hardwood at +1.5" over 3/4" subfloor; second-storey oak/tile/carpet all land at +1.5" (flush).
Paint/coatings: latex-paint 0.01" layer is a zero-depth coating by design; A-516 section labels gwb 0.5" / stud 3.5" correctly.
A-603 lists floor/ceiling finishes consistent with the model's room finish refs.
COREtec Quincy Oak VV017-01018 is 5 mm with attached cork (manufacturer page): LVP 0.19685" correct.
layer_bands.py / coatings.py: bands clamp to the wall, reband re-resolves top=None, coatings return 0 depth and re-host on the solved face; no bug found.
Sampled opening/rim sheets A-516, A-519, A-520, A-521, A-525, A-528, A-530, A-579, A-583: printed layer thicknesses and stud widths equal model values.

findings.title: Bedroom carpet stack modelled at 3/4" over subfloor; selected carpet + 7/16" cushion + 1/4" plywood allowance is ~1.25-1.35"

evidence.measured: finish_thickness_in=0.75 for the whole carpet stack; the same material lists companions pad 7/16" (0.4375) + carpet-underlayment 1/4" (0.25) and the carpet's published pile is 0.56" (+ unreported backing). Sum of the cited layers >= 0.4375+0.25+0.56 = 1.25" before backing and before pad compression. Web pass 2: Quincy Oak confirmed 5 mm incl. attached cork (coretecfloors.com), so LVP 0.197" is right; Sweet Spot I has no published total thickness (backing excluded from 0.56" pile), but the two PUBLISHED numbers alone (cushion 7/16" + pile 0.56") already give 0.9975" > 0.75" even with plywood dropped.
evidence.expected: Minimum published stack 1.0" (no plywood, no backing) or ~1.25" with the 1/4" plywood allowance, vs 0.75" modelled: carpet floors 0.25-0.5" high of the hall oak at +1.5".
evidence.method: Load /tmp pickle; room_finished_floor_elevation - room_floor_elevation = 1.5" for carpet rooms (probe p3.py). Compare materials_flooring.py companions. Known provisional (bedroom_carpet.md) but nothing in the model/set flags it as unreconciled.

findings.source: notes/bedroom_carpet.md (own admission); Future Foam 150553488-33 7/16"; STAINMASTER 7L89100101 0.56" pile
findings.proposed_fix: Model carpet at >=1.0" (cushion 7/16 + pile 0.56) or choose 3/8" cushion + <=0.4" pile (~0.78"); delete the plywood allowance if not needed. Re-strike with doorway heights.

findings.title: No transition product exists at any flooring change; 0.553" LVP-to-carpet step at D-M-BED2 exceeds a stock reducer/ramp range

evidence.measured: 58 integrity.doorway_assembly UNKNOWN; every doorway with a floor change has components=() and 'compatible flooring trim or documented transition is unspecified'. Steps (in): D-M-BED2 0.553, D-S-PLANT 0.38, D-B-SAUNA 0.75 (concrete to stall mat), D-B-PLAY 0.25, D-A-HALVES 0.63.
evidence.expected: A named transition product per change with its height range covering the step (stock carpet-to-hard-surface reducers/ramps typically cover <= ~1/2"; steps over 1/4" need a bevel).
evidence.method: p4.py: open each o.doorway; print adjacent_floors surface_m, components, unknown.

findings.source: floor_heights.md (saddle intent only); no product named
findings.proposed_fix: Select transition products (or author the hardwood saddle and stall-mat reducers as Products) so doorway_assembly can grade the range; for D-M-BED2 consider matching carpet to 0.947" or stepping the saddle.

findings.title: J-bead is Phillips JT6 listed for 5/8" board but 20 terminations sit on 1/2" board (and Trim-Tex J sizes are board-specific)

evidence.measured: Product source reads 'listed for 5/8 in. board. Confirm the 1/2 in. part'; walls the terminations meet are 1/2" (INT_2X4_PARTITION_HALF etc, probe p6.py); 20 'termination' trims, ~1,800 in of J-bead.
evidence.expected: J-bead size matches board: 1/2" J (Phillips 1/2" metal J 8 ft, Trim-Tex 1/2" J) for 1/2" walls.
evidence.method: p5.py lists terminations; p6.py gypsum thickness per wall assembly. Web: Menards JT6 page lists 5/8" J; Phillips 1/2" x 8' metal J exists; Trim-Tex catalog 1510 (1/2") / 1610 (5/8").

findings.source: drywall.py own source string; https://trim-tex.com catalog 2024
findings.proposed_fix: Swap to a 1/2" J-bead product (stock may become 8 ft) or use 5/8" only where the board is 5/8"; check stock_length.

findings.title: Tile stacks carry 0.10-0.15" of combined mortar under 24x48 / large tile; DITRA-HEAT is 5.5 mm (0.217") not 0.25"

evidence.measured: Each stack is forced to 0.75": Opera Blue = 0.25+0.40+0.10; Kaleo = 0.3125+0.3125+0.125; Carrara = 0.25+0.354+0.146. Tile thickness for Opera Blue/Kaleo is an unpublished allowance.
evidence.expected: A thinset under the membrane (~1/16") plus a tile bed over DITRA studs (>= ~1/8-3/16") for large-format tile suggests 0.19-0.25" mortar; tile-to-oak flush (+/-1/16") target in floor_heights.md will not hold at 0.10".
evidence.method: Read materials_flooring.py source strings; web: DITRA-HEAT 5.5 mm sheet (ceramed.ca listing); Agua Linda 10.16 mm per product row.

findings.source: Schluter DITRA-HEAT 5.5mm retail data (not Schluter datasheet); product rows 'thickness not published'
findings.proposed_fix: Get delivered tile thickness; re-derive mortar as a minimum, set finished height from the sum, and adjust oak/tile flush by underlayment.

findings.title: SurePly 'nominal 1/4"' used as the actual thickness (real ~0.205"/5.2 mm) in the plant-room and carpet stacks

evidence.measured: catlin-plant-vinyl-raised finish_thickness_in=0.370 (0.120 sheet + 0.25 plywood); D-S-PLANT step 0.38".
evidence.method: Lowe's Patriot Timber 1/4" underlayment actual 0.205" (inference; SurePly datasheet not found).

findings.proposed_fix: Set 0.325 (verify SurePly sheet); re-check the reducer/water-stop riser height.

findings.title: Interior-partition rim-band sheets print exterior air/water/thermal continuity notes (sheathing-ext, spray-foam-ext)

evidence.measured: A-567 (INT_2X4_PARTITION_HALF rim band, page 102) shows 'air continuity - sheathing-ext -> sheathing-ext / water ... spray-foam-ext / thermal ... spray-foam-ext' on a gypsum/stud partition that has neither layer. Same AIR_WATER_THERMAL tuple is on every storey_stack:rim:* and stack_width_change key. Re-confirmed on A-579 (mudroom bearing wall / stair wall, p114) and A-583 (INT_2X6_PLUMBING_HALF / staggered, p118): same three continuity labels on interior-to-interior rim bands.
evidence.expected: Interior partition keys carry no envelope continuity note (only the plant rim band's vapour-barrier claim and envelope keys).
evidence.method: Read permit_set_full.pdf p102 (A-567) and p51 (A-516, no such note); transitions.py CATR003AAAA/CATR004AAAA continuity=AIR_WATER_THERMAL.

findings.proposed_fix: Give interior-only stacks a continuity=() variant (or condition the continuity on the stack having an envelope layer).

findings.title: RM-B-SAUNA clear_height_m reads 96.94" but the shiplap ceiling underside is 83.06" AFF (CLAUDE.md says 82 13/16")

evidence.measured: ceiling z0=-26.375" vs sauna floor -109.4375" = 83.06"; room.clear_height_m = 96.94" (floor to joist/ slab only); documented 82.8125" differs by 1/4". A-528 (p63) note prints 'finished ceiling at 82 13/16 inches' while the model ceiling gives 83.06".
evidence.expected: clear height = lowest ceiling underside; reconcile 83.06 vs 82.81 (bench/sealed-concrete top).
evidence.method: p7.py ceilings; p3.py room clear heights.

findings.proposed_fix: Make clear_height_m read a lowered ceiling (not only soffits) or document the exemption; settle the 1/4" discrepancy.

findings.title: 1/2" paper-faced abuse-resistant board (gwb-ar) used on hall/stair/mudroom faces has no US 1/2" listing found

evidence.measured: Material source already says a supply-yard item; search found USG AR only as 5/8" Type X (US) and a 1/2" AR Firecode C from CGC (Canada).
evidence.expected: A US-orderable 1/2" AR board, or the stated 1/2" regular/Type C substitute.
evidence.method: WebSearch ASTM C1629 USG Sheetrock AR thicknesses.

findings.source: usg.com AR Firecode X (5/8"); bmr.ca CGC AR Firecode C 1/2"
findings.proposed_fix: Name the substitute (1/2" Type C or regular) as the default in the material note; keep AR as a 5/8" Type X option where space allows.

findings.title: Title/legend text overprints and clips on interior opening detail sheets (A-519, A-530, A-520)

evidence.measured: A-519 and A-530: a second 'Catlin House / detail title / MATERIALS ... 0.625"/0.01"' text block is drawn on top of itself at upper left, illegible; A-520 has a clipped fragment 'ening' at the page's left edge.
evidence.expected: One legible title/materials block per detail sheet.

findings.proposed_fix: Fix the detail-sheet legend placement so it is not drawn twice and clips inside the border (same family as F5's A-588/589 overlap).

findings.title: Gypsum type not printed on opening details: 5/8" Type X wall labelled only 'gwb-a/gwb-b'

evidence.measured: A-519 (INT_2X6_BRG, gwb-x 5/8 both faces in the model) labels 'gwb-b 0.625" / gwb-a 0.625"' with no type; A-530 and A-579 label the same board 'gwb-x 0.625"'. Thicknesses on all sampled sheets (0.5 / 0.625 / 3.5 / 5.5 stud) match the model.
evidence.expected: Layer labels name the board type (Type X / AR / MR) consistently; fire-rated board is a field-checked item.
evidence.method: Compare p54 label text to model wall layers (p6.py: INT_2X6_BRG gwb-x 0.625).

findings.proposed_fix: Label layers by material tag (gwb-x) not by layer name role where the layer name is gwb-a/gwb-b.
